title: A Line--Search--Based Stochastic Gradient Method for 3D Computed Tomography
summary: We introduce FB-LISA, a forward-backward (FB) generalization of a recently proposed line-search-based stochastic gradient algorithm to address the imaging problem of volumetric reconstruction in Computed Tomography, a substantially high demanding problem, which involves orders of magnitude of data, a high computational burden for forward and backprojection, and memory requirements that push current GPU architectures to their limits.
